--- .github/workflows/build.yml	
+++ .github/workflows/build.yml	
@@ -1,54 +1,64 @@
 name: Build overlay APK
 
 on:
   push:
   workflow_dispatch:
 
 permissions:
   contents: write
 
 jobs:
   build:
     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
     steps:
       - uses: actions/checkout@v4
 
       - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
         with:
           distribution: temurin
           java-version: '17'
 
       - name: Android SDK
         run: |
           yes | "$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager" --licenses || true
           "$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager" "platforms;android-34" "build-tools;34.0.0"
 
       - name: EN→RU словарик для перевода (из overlay-translator, ~2MB)
         run: |
           mkdir -p app/src/main/assets/dict
           curl -fL -o app/src/main/assets/dict/en_ru.json https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sj0404-collab/overlay-translator/master/app/src/main/assets/dict/en_ru.json
           du -sh app/src/main/assets
 
       - name: Gradle 8.7
         run: |
           curl -fL -o gradle.zip https://services.gradle.org/distributions/gradle-8.7-bin.zip
           unzip -q gradle.zip
 
+      - name: Unit tests (debug)
+        run: ./gradle-8.7/bin/gradle :app:testDebugUnitTest --no-daemon --stacktrace
+
       - name: Build release APK
         run: ./gradle-8.7/bin/gradle :app:assembleRelease --no-daemon --stacktrace
 
+      - name: Upload test report
+        if: failure()
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          name: test-report
+          path: app/build/reports/tests/testDebugUnitTest
+
       - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
         with:
           name: apk
           path: app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk
 
       - name: GitHub Release (on tag)
         if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')
         run: |
           mv app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk "yomikai-overlay-${{ github.ref_name }}.apk"
           gh release create "${{ github.ref_name }}" \
             --title "Yomikai Оверлей ${{ github.ref_name }}" \
             --notes "Плавающий OCR-оверлей поверх других приложений (интерфейс как плавающее меню читалки)." \
             "yomikai-overlay-${{ github.ref_name }}.apk" || true
         env:
           GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

--- README.md	
+++ README.md	
@@ -1,31 +1,41 @@
 # Yomikai Оверлей — плавающий OCR-читатель поверх других приложений
 
 Отдельное приложение: плавающая кнопка поверх любых приложений (игры, сайты, скрины), тап — меню как в читалке Yomikai:
 
 - **OCR скан** — разово распознать рамку и прочитать текст вслух
-- **Авточтение** — читает рамку и листает автопрокруткой (жест свайпа через спец. возможности)
+- **Авточтение** — читает рамку и листает автопрокруткой (жест свайпа через спец. возможности); останавливается сам, если текст в рамке перестал меняться
 - **Стоп чтения**
-- **Голос** ♀ / ♂ / ⚙ (тембр системного TTS; настройки синтеза)
+- **Голос** ♀ / ♂ / ⚙ (тембр системного TTS; сетевые голоса Edge + список для выбора; проба голоса тапом)
 - **Скорость** −/+/1× (50%…200%)
-- **Движок** — Tesseract RU+EN (офлайн, кириллица)
+- **Движок** — только онлайн: Google Lens (без ключа) / Zen Free (ИИ-хаб, фолбэк на Lens) / Google AI Gemini Vision / OpenRouter Vision
+- **Перевод** ⇄ — латиница → русский перед озвучкой (Zen → Google Translate → MyMemory)
 - **Область** — пресеты (весь экран/верх/центр/низ), **удержание** — рамку тянуть за 4 ручки по сторонам + угол
 - Панель вниз / Скрыть пузырь 30 с / Закрыть (удержание)
 
 ## Установка
 1. Скачать APK из Releases, установить.
 2. Разрешить **«Показ поверх других приложений»** (из кнопки в приложении).
 3. Для автопрокрутки: включить **«Yomikai Оверлей — прокрутка»** в спец. возможностях.
    Если пишет **«Доступ к настройкам ограничен»** (Android 13+, установка APK-файлом):
    Сведения о приложении → ⋮ правый верхний угол → **«Разрешить ограниченные настройки»** → вернуться и включить службу.
 4. При первом скане/чтении система спросит разрешение на захват экрана — это системный диалог, появляется каждый новый запуск сервиса.
 
 ## Архитектура
 - UI — нативные View (не Compose в окнах): класс крашей `ViewTreeLifecycleOwner not found` исключён полностью.
 - `OverlayService` — bubble + панель + рамка + захват + OCR + TTS + цикл чтения.
 - Двухфазный foreground: `mediaPlayback` при старте → `mediaPlayback|mediaProjection` после consent (фикс SecurityException Android 14+).
 - `ScrollAccessibilityService` — свайп-листание в других приложениях.
 - `CaptureConsentActivity` — прозрачная activity для системного запроса захвата.
+- Озвучка: сетевые голоса Edge (WebSocket, как «Читать вслух» в Edge), фолбэк — системный TTS.
+- Чистая логика (пресеты рамки `Region`, движки `Engines`, скорость `Rates`) вынесена в `app.yomikaioverlay.ot` и покрыта юнит-тестами.
 
 ## Сборка
-GitHub Actions (`.github/workflows/build.yml`): ubuntu-latest, JDK 17, Gradle 8.7, tesseract data скачивается в CI, release собирается на тег.
+GitHub Actions (`.github/workflows/build.yml`): ubuntu-latest, JDK 17, Gradle 8.7. Перед сборкой прогоняются юнит-тесты (`:app:testDebugUnitTest`, 40+ тестов: геометрия рамки, движки, скорость, детект скрипта, чистка текста LLM, протобуф Lens, чанки Edge TTS). Release собирается на тег.
 Подпись — `keystore/yomikai-overlay.jks` в репозитории (личный проект; пароль в `app/build.gradle`).
+
+Локально (нужны JDK 17, Android SDK 34 и Gradle 8.7 — как в CI):
+```bash
+gradle :app:testDebugUnitTest   # тесты
+gradle :app:assembleDebug       # debug APK
+gradle :app:assembleRelease     # release APK
+```

+ * Единый источник правды по OCR-движкам: порядок перебора, легаси-алиасы,
+ * человекочитаемые названия и признак «нужен ключ». Раньше эта логика
+ * дублировалась в MainActivity и OverlayService и могла разъехаться.
+ */
+object Engines {
+    const val LENS = "lens"
+    const val ZEN = "zen"
+    const val GOOGLE_AI = "googleai"
+    const val OPENROUTER = "openrouter"
+
+    /** Порядок перебора движка по тапу. */
+    val CYCLE = listOf(LENS, ZEN, GOOGLE_AI, OPENROUTER)
+
+    /** Следующий движок по кругу. */
+    fun next(current: String?): String {
+        val i = CYCLE.indexOf(current)
+        return if (i < 0) CYCLE[0] else CYCLE[(i + 1) % CYCLE.size]
+    }
+
+    /**
+     * Приводит id к поддерживаемому: старые оффлайн-движки (tesseract/модели)
+     * и мусор из префов схлопываются к бесключевому Lens.
+     */
+    fun normalize(id: String?): String = if (CYCLE.contains(id)) id!! else LENS
+
+    /** Короткое название для кнопок. */
+    fun title(id: String?): String = when (normalize(id)) {
+        ZEN -> "Zen Free (онлайн, без ключа)"
+        GOOGLE_AI -> "Google AI Gemini Vision"
+        OPENROUTER -> "OpenRouter Vision"
+        else -> "Google Lens (онлайн)"
+    }
+
+    /** Подпись-пояснение под названием. */
+    fun subtitle(id: String?): String = when (normalize(id)) {
+        ZEN -> "бесплатный ИИ-хаб, фолбэк — Lens"
+        GOOGLE_AI -> "gemini, строгий OCR (ключ)"
+        OPENROUTER -> "vision-модели через OpenRouter (ключ)"
+        else -> "бесключевой endpoint — самый простой"
+    }
+
+    /** Нужен ли пользовательский API-ключ. */
+    fun needsKey(id: String?): Boolean = when (normalize(id)) {

+package app.yomikaioverlay.ot
+
+import kotlin.math.roundToInt
+
+/**
+ * Скорость озвучки: шаг 25%, диапазон 50…200%. Чистые функции, чтобы
+ * MainActivity и панель оверлея считали одинаково (и без Android).
+ */
+object Rates {
+    const val MIN = 0.5f
+    const val MAX = 2.0f
+    const val STEP = 0.25f
+
+    /** Приводит значение к сетке шагов 25% внутри [MIN]..[MAX]. */
+    fun clamp(rate: Float): Float {
+        val snapped = if (Math.abs(rate - 1.0f) < 0.01f) 1.0f else rate
+        val stepped = Math.round(snapped / STEP) * STEP
+        return (stepped.coerceIn(MIN, MAX) * 100f).roundToInt() / 100f
+    }
+
+    /** Сдвиг на [delta] с приведением к сетке. */
+    fun step(current: Float, delta: Float): Float = clamp(current + delta)
+
+    /** Перебор по кругу: 1.0 → 1.25 → … → 2.0 → 0.5 → 0.75 → 1.0. */
+    fun nextCycle(current: Float): Float {
+        var r = clamp(current) + STEP
+        if (r > MAX) r = MIN
+        return clamp(r)
+    }
+
+    /** Проценты для подписи: 1.0 → «100%». */
+    fun percent(rate: Float): Int = (clamp(rate) * 100).roundToInt()
+}

+package app.yomikaioverlay.ot
+
+/**
+ * Пресеты OCR-рамки и безопасная геометрия: чистые функции над размерами
+ * экрана (без Android-типов), чтобы логику можно было покрыть юнит-тестами.
+ *
+ * Все координаты — в пикселях экрана, рамка всегда остаётся внутри экрана
+ * и не выворачивается наизнанку при перетаскивании ручек.
+ */
+object Region {
+    const val PRESET_BOTTOM = "bottom"
+    const val PRESET_FULL = "full"
+    const val PRESET_TOP = "top"
+    const val PRESET_CENTER = "center"
+    const val PRESET_CUSTOM = "custom"
+
+    /** Порядок перебора пресетов по тапу. */
+    val CYCLE = listOf(PRESET_BOTTOM, PRESET_FULL, PRESET_TOP, PRESET_CENTER)
+
+    /** Рамка «Нижняя половина» — дефолт при первом запуске. */
+    val DEFAULT_RATIOS = floatArrayOf(0.025f, 0.55f, 0.975f, 0.98f)
+
+    /** Прямоугольник в пикселях (замена android.graphics.Rect для чистых функций). */
+    data class Box(
+        val left: Int,
+        val top: Int,
+        val right: Int,
+        val bottom: Int,
+    ) {
+        val width: Int get() = right - left
+        val height: Int get() = bottom - top
+    }
+
+    /** Следующий пресет по кругу. Неизвестное/своя рамка → «Нижняя половина». */
+    fun nextPreset(current: String?): String {
+        val i = CYCLE.indexOf(current)
+        return if (i < 0) PRESET_BOTTOM else CYCLE[(i + 1) % CYCLE.size]
+    }
+
+    /** Любая строка из префов → валидный id пресета (custom сохраняется). */
+    fun normalizePreset(preset: String?): String = when (preset) {
+        in CYCLE -> preset!!
+        PRESET_CUSTOM -> PRESET_CUSTOM
+        else -> PRESET_BOTTOM
+    }
+
+    /** Рамка пресета в пикселях экрана [w]x[h]. */
+    fun rectFor(preset: String?, w: Int, h: Int): Box {
+        val ww = w.coerceAtLeast(1)
+        val hh = h.coerceAtLeast(1)
+        return when (preset) {
+            PRESET_FULL -> Box(0, 0, ww, hh)
+            PRESET_TOP -> Box(0, 0, ww, hh / 2)
+            PRESET_CENTER -> Box(0, (hh * 0.25f).toInt(), ww, (hh * 0.75f).toInt())
+            else -> Box(
+                (ww * 0.025f).toInt(),
+                (hh * 0.55f).toInt(),
+                (ww * 0.975f).toInt(),
+                (hh * 0.98f).toInt(),
+            )
+        }
+    }
+
+    /** Человекочитаемое имя пресета. */
+    fun label(preset: String?): String = when (preset) {
+        PRESET_FULL -> "Весь экран"
+        PRESET_TOP -> "Верхняя половина"
+        PRESET_CENTER -> "Центральная половина"
+        PRESET_BOTTOM -> "Нижняя половина"
+        else -> "Своя рамка"
+    }
+
+    /** Доли (l, t, r, b) рамки на экране [w]x[h]. */
+    fun ratiosOf(box: Box, w: Int, h: Int): FloatArray {
+        val ww = w.coerceAtLeast(1).toFloat()
+        val hh = h.coerceAtLeast(1).toFloat()
+        return floatArrayOf(
+            box.left / ww, box.top / hh, box.right / ww, box.bottom / hh,
+        )
+    }
+
+    /** Рамка из долей (l, t, r, b) на экране [w]x[h]. */
+    fun boxFromRatios(l: Float, t: Float, r: Float, b: Float, w: Int, h: Int): Box {
+        val ww = w.coerceAtLeast(1)
+        val hh = h.coerceAtLeast(1)
+        val left = (ww * l.coerceIn(0f, 1f)).toInt().coerceIn(0, ww - 1)
+        var right = (ww * r.coerceIn(0f, 1f)).toInt().coerceIn(0, ww)
+        if (right <= left) right = (left + 1).coerceAtMost(ww)
+        val top = (hh * t.coerceIn(0f, 1f)).toInt().coerceIn(0, hh - 1)
+        var bottom = (hh * b.coerceIn(0f, 1f)).toInt().coerceIn(0, hh)
+        if (bottom <= top) bottom = (top + 1).coerceAtMost(hh)
+        return Box(left, top, right, bottom)
+    }
+
+    /**
+     * Приводит рамку к экрану [w]x[h] и минимальному размеру [minW]x[minH]
+     * без инверсии сторон: при перетаскивании ручки/рамки результат всегда
+     * остаётся валидным прямоугольником внутри экрана.
+     */
+    fun clamp(box: Box, w: Int, h: Int, minW: Int, minH: Int): Box {
+        val ww = w.coerceAtLeast(1)
+        val hh = h.coerceAtLeast(1)
+        val minWidth = minW.coerceIn(1, ww)
+        val minHeight = minH.coerceIn(1, hh)
+        var left = box.left.coerceIn(0, ww - minWidth)
+        var right = box.right.coerceIn(left + minWidth, ww)
+        var top = box.top.coerceIn(0, hh - minHeight)
+        var bottom = box.bottom.coerceIn(top + minHeight, hh)
+        // Страхование от инверсии при экране меньше минимальной рамки.
+        if (right - left < minWidth) {
+            right = (left + minWidth).coerceAtMost(ww)
+            left = (right - minWidth).coerceAtLeast(0)
+        }
+        if (bottom - top < minHeight) {
+            bottom = (top + minHeight).coerceAtMost(hh)
+            top = (bottom - minHeight).coerceAtLeast(0)
+        }
+        return Box(left, top, right, bottom)
+    }
+}

 class Translator(private val ctx: Context) {
     private val dictionary by lazy { LocalDictionary(ctx) }
 
     fun translate(text: String, engine: String, mode: String = EnginePrefs.MODE_MIXED): String {

         if (ScriptDetect.isMostlyCyrillic(cleaned)) return cleaned

             EnginePrefs.TR_DICT -> dictionary.translateFragment(cleaned)
             EnginePrefs.TR_GOOGLE -> MangaTranslatorService.translate(cleaned)
             EnginePrefs.TR_GOOGLE_AI -> onlineTokens(cleaned,
                 LlmClient.translateGemini(ctx, cleaned)
                     ?: MangaTranslatorService.translate(cleaned))
             EnginePrefs.TR_ZEN -> onlineTokens(cleaned,
                 LlmClient.translateZen(cleaned, EnginePrefs.zenModel(ctx))
                     ?: MangaTranslatorService.translate(cleaned))
             EnginePrefs.TR_OPENROUTER -> onlineTokens(cleaned,
                 LlmClient.translateOpenRouter(cleaned, EnginePrefs.openrouterKey(ctx), EnginePrefs.orModel(ctx))
                     ?: LlmClient.translateZen(cleaned, EnginePrefs.zenModel(ctx))
                     ?: MangaTranslatorService.translate(cleaned))
             EnginePrefs.TR_MYMEMORY -> mymemory(cleaned)
                 ?: MangaTranslatorService.translate(cleaned)
             else -> { // "auto" — Zen → Google Translate Free → MyMemory
-                onlineTokens(cleaned,
-                    LlmClient.translateZen(cleaned, EnginePrefs.zenModel(ctx))
-                        ?: MangaTranslatorService.translate(cleaned)
-                        ?: mymemory(cleaned))
+                val zen = LlmClient.translateZen(cleaned, EnginePrefs.zenModel(ctx))
+                val google = zen ?: MangaTranslatorService.translateOrNull(cleaned)
+                val my = google ?: mymemory(cleaned)
+                onlineTokens(cleaned, my)
             }
         }.let { RuText.clean(it ?: "") }
     }
 
     /** Rough token accounting (≈4 chars per token) for online LLM routes. */
     private fun onlineTokens(text: String, result: String?): String? {
         EnginePrefs.incrementTokens(ctx, ((text.length / 4) + (result?.length?.div(8) ?: 0)).toLong())
         return result
     }
 
     @Suppress("SameParameterValue")
     private fun mymemory(text: String): String? = runCatching {
         val q = java.net.URLEncoder.encode(text.take(450), "UTF-8")
         val c = java.net.URL("https://api.mymemory.translated.net/get?q=$q&langpair=en|ru")
             .openConnection() as java.net.HttpURLConnection
         c.connectTimeout = 6000; c.readTimeout = 8000
         val body = c.inputStream.bufferedReader().readText()
         c.disconnect()
         val tr = org.json.JSONObject(body).getJSONObject("responseData").optString("translatedText")
         if (tr.isNullOrBlank() || tr.contains("MYMEMORY", true)) null else tr

+package app.yomikaioverlay
+
+import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
+import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
+import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
+import org.junit.Test
+
+/**
+ * Edge TTS: протокол и разбиение длинных текстов.
+ * Сеть здесь не трогаем — только чистые функции (токен, экранирование, чанки).
+ */
+class EdgeTtsTest {
+
+    @Test
+    fun `secMsGec is deterministic uppercase hex`() {
+        val a = EdgeTts.secMsGec(1_000_000L)
+        val b = EdgeTts.secMsGec(1_000_000L)
+        assertEquals(a, b)
+        assertEquals(64, a.length)
+        assertTrue("must be uppercase hex", a.all { it.isDigit() || it in 'A'..'F' })
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun `secMsGec is stable inside 5 minute bucket and changes across it`() {
+        // WIN_EPOCH кратен 300, поэтому граница бакета совпадает с эпохой
+        val base = 600L
+        assertEquals(EdgeTts.secMsGec(base), EdgeTts.secMsGec(base + 1))
+        assertEquals(EdgeTts.secMsGec(base), EdgeTts.secMsGec(base + 299))
+        assertFalse(EdgeTts.secMsGec(base) == EdgeTts.secMsGec(base + 300))
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun `escapeXml escapes xml specials`() {
+        assertEquals(
+            "a<b>c&d"e'f",
+            EdgeTts.escapeXml("a<b>c&d\"e'f"),
+        )
+        assertEquals("", EdgeTts.escapeXml(""))
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun `short text goes in one chunk`() {
+        val chunks = EdgeTts.chunkForSsml("Привет, мир!")
+        assertEquals(1, chunks.size)
+        assertEquals("Привет, мир!", chunks[0])
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun `blank text produces no chunks`() {
+        assertTrue(EdgeTts.chunkForSsml("").isEmpty())
+        assertTrue(EdgeTts.chunkForSsml("   ").isEmpty())
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun `long text splits without losing content`() {
+        val text = buildString {
+            var i = 0
+            while (length < 20_000) append("слово${i++} ")
+        }
+        val chunks = EdgeTts.chunkForSsml(text, limit = 1000)
+        assertTrue("must be multiple chunks", chunks.size > 5)
+        for (c in chunks) {
+            assertTrue("chunk must fit limit", c.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8).size <= 1000)
+        }
+        // содержимое сохраняется: все непробельные символы на месте
+        assertEquals(
+            text.filterNot { it.isWhitespace() },
+            chunks.joinToString(" ").filterNot { it.isWhitespace() },
+        )
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun `chunks never end inside xml entity`() {
+        val text = buildString {
+            var i = 0
+            while (length < 12_000) append("cue&ref${i++} & tail ")
+        }
+        for (c in EdgeTts.chunkForSsml(text, limit = 500)) {
+            assertTrue("chunk must fit byte limit", c.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8).size <= 500)
+            assertFalse("chunk ends with bare &", c.endsWith("&"))
+            assertFalse("chunk ends with partial entity", c.endsWith("&am"))
+        }
+    }

+    @Test
+    fun `tail shorter than limit does not crash`() {
+        // Ровно 4100 байт: раньше последний хвост < limit ронял substring'ом.
+        val text = "x".repeat(4100)
+        val chunks = EdgeTts.chunkForSsml(text)
+        assertEquals(2, chunks.size)
+        assertEquals(4000, chunks[0].length)
+        assertEquals(100, chunks[1].length)
+    }

+        val bytes = ProtoWriter().apply {
+            writeMessage(1) {
+                it.writeString(1, "ru")
+                it.writeMessage(2) { i2 -> i2.writeInt32(1, 42) }
+            }
+            writeUInt64(2, 987_654_321L)
+            writeBytes(3, byteArrayOf(0, 1, 2, 3))
+        }.toByteArray()
+
+        val r = ProtoReader(bytes)
+        val t1 = r.readTag()!!
+        assertEquals(1, t1 ushr 3)
+        val msg = ProtoReader(r.readBytes())
+
+        val s1 = msg.readTag()!!
+        assertEquals(1, s1 ushr 3)
+        assertEquals("ru", msg.readString())
+
+        val s2 = msg.readTag()!!
+        assertEquals(2, s2 ushr 3)
+        val inner = ProtoReader(msg.readBytes())
+        val s3 = inner.readTag()!!
+        assertEquals(1, s3 ushr 3)
+        assertEquals(42, inner.readVarint32())
+
+        val t2 = r.readTag()!!
+        assertEquals(2, t2 ushr 3)
+        assertEquals(987_654_321L, r.readVarint32()!!.toLong())
+
+        val t3 = r.readTag()!!
+        assertEquals(3, t3 ushr 3)
+        assertArrayEquals(byteArrayOf(0, 1, 2, 3), r.readBytes())
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun `request payload carries png and dimensions`() {
+        val png = byteArrayOf(9, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1)
+        val payload = GlensOcrEngine().buildRequestPayload(png, 800, 600)
+
+        val top = ProtoReader(payload)
+        val tag = top.readTag()!!
+        assertEquals(1, tag ushr 3)
+        assertEquals(2, tag and 0x7) // length-delimited
+
+        val req = ProtoReader(top.readBytes())
+        var pngOut: ByteArray? = null
+        var width = -1
+        var height = -1
+        var contextSeen = false
+        var clientLang = ""
+        while (req.hasRemaining()) {
+            val t = req.readTag() ?: break
+            val f = t ushr 3
+            when {
+                f == 1 -> { // objects_request_context
+                    contextSeen = true
+                    val ctx = ProtoReader(req.readBytes())
+                    while (ctx.hasRemaining()) {
+                        val tc = ctx.readTag() ?: break
+                        if ((tc ushr 3) == 4) {
+                            val cc = ProtoReader(ctx.readBytes())
+                            while (cc.hasRemaining()) {
+                                val tcc = cc.readTag() ?: break
+                                if ((tcc ushr 3) == 4) { // locale_context
+                                    val lc = ProtoReader(cc.readBytes())
+                                    val tl = lc.readTag()!!
+                                    assertEquals(1, tl ushr 3)
+                                    clientLang = lc.readString()
+                                } else cc.skipField(tcc and 0x7)
+                            }
+                        } else ctx.skipField(tc and 0x7)
+                    }
+                }
+                f == 3 -> { // image_data
+                    val img = ProtoReader(req.readBytes())
+                    while (img.hasRemaining()) {
+                        val ti = img.readTag() ?: break
+                        when (ti ushr 3) {
+                            1 -> { // payload message
+                                val pl = ProtoReader(img.readBytes())
+                                val tp = pl.readTag()!!
+                                assertEquals(1, tp ushr 3)
+                                pngOut = pl.readBytes()
+                            }
+                            3 -> { // dimensions
+                                val dm = ProtoReader(img.readBytes())
+                                val tw = dm.readTag()!!
+                                assertEquals(1, tw ushr 3)
+                                width = dm.readVarint32()!!
+                                val th = dm.readTag()!!
+                                assertEquals(2, th ushr 3)
+                                height = dm.readVarint32()!!
+                            }
+                            else -> img.skipField(ti and 0x7)
+                        }
+                    }
+                }
+                else -> req.skipField(t and 0x7)
+            }
+        }
+        assertTrue("objects_request_context missing", contextSeen)
+        assertEquals("ru", clientLang)
+        assertArrayEquals("png bytes must survive the encode", png, pngOut)
+        assertEquals(800, width)
+        assertEquals(600, height)
+    }
+}

+    @Test

+        assertEquals(1.25f, Rates.clamp(1.3f), 0.001f)
+        assertEquals(0.5f, Rates.clamp(0.1f), 0.001f)

+        assertEquals(0.5f, Rates.step(0.5f, -Rates.STEP), 0.001f) // пол
+        assertEquals(2.0f, Rates.step(2.0f, 0.0f), 0.001f)
+    }
+
+    @Test

+package app.yomikaioverlay.ot
+
+import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
+import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
+import org.junit.Test
+
+/**
+ * Пресеты и геометрия рамки: регрессия на баг «reg_preset затирался на custom»,
+ * из-за которого пресеты «Верхняя половина»/«Центральная половина» были
+ * недостижимы, и на инверсию сторон при перетаскивании ручек.
+ */
+class RegionTest {
+
+    @Test
+    fun `nextPreset cycles all four presets`() {
+        assertEquals(Region.PRESET_FULL, Region.nextPreset(Region.PRESET_BOTTOM))
+        assertEquals(Region.PRESET_TOP, Region.nextPreset(Region.PRESET_FULL))
+        assertEquals(Region.PRESET_CENTER, Region.nextPreset(Region.PRESET_TOP))
+        assertEquals(Region.PRESET_BOTTOM, Region.nextPreset(Region.PRESET_CENTER))
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun `nextPreset from custom or garbage restarts at bottom`() {
+        assertEquals(Region.PRESET_BOTTOM, Region.nextPreset(Region.PRESET_CUSTOM))
+        assertEquals(Region.PRESET_BOTTOM, Region.nextPreset("tesseract-legacy"))
+        assertEquals(Region.PRESET_BOTTOM, Region.nextPreset(null))
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun `normalizePreset keeps only known ids`() {
+        assertEquals(Region.PRESET_TOP, Region.normalizePreset(Region.PRESET_TOP))
+        assertEquals(Region.PRESET_CUSTOM, Region.normalizePreset(Region.PRESET_CUSTOM))
+        assertEquals(Region.PRESET_BOTTOM, Region.normalizePreset("fullscreen-v99"))
+        assertEquals(Region.PRESET_BOTTOM, Region.normalizePreset(null))
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun `rectFor matches expected shares of screen`() {
+        val w = 1000
+        val h = 2000
+        assertEquals(Region.Box(0, 0, 1000, 2000), Region.rectFor(Region.PRESET_FULL, w, h))
+        assertEquals(Region.Box(0, 0, 1000, 1000), Region.rectFor(Region.PRESET_TOP, w, h))
+        assertEquals(Region.Box(0, 500, 1000, 1500), Region.rectFor(Region.PRESET_CENTER, w, h))
+        // bottom == DEFAULT_RATIOS
+        assertEquals(
+            Region.Box(25, 1100, 975, 1960),
+            Region.rectFor(Region.PRESET_BOTTOM, w, h),
+        )
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun `label is human readable per preset`() {
+        assertEquals("Весь экран", Region.label(Region.PRESET_FULL))
+        assertEquals("Верхняя половина", Region.label(Region.PRESET_TOP))
+        assertEquals("Центральная половина", Region.label(Region.PRESET_CENTER))
+        assertEquals("Нижняя половина", Region.label(Region.PRESET_BOTTOM))
+        assertEquals("Своя рамка", Region.label(Region.PRESET_CUSTOM))
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun `box survives ratio round trip`() {
+        // степени двойки — round trip точен без плавающих поправок
+        val box = Region.Box(256, 128, 768, 512)
+        val r = Region.ratiosOf(box, 1024, 1024)
+        val back = Region.boxFromRatios(r[0], r[1], r[2], r[3], 1024, 1024)
+        assertEquals(box, back)
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun `boxFromRatios tolerates garbage ratios`() {
+        val box = Region.boxFromRatios(-5f, 2f, 0.5f, 0.25f, 1000, 2000)
+        assertTrue("left must be >= 0", box.left >= 0)
+        assertTrue("top must be < bottom", box.top < box.bottom)
+        assertTrue("right within screen", box.right <= 1000)
+        assertTrue("bottom within screen", box.bottom <= 2000)
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun `clamp keeps box inside screen with min size`() {
+        val s = Region.clamp(Region.Box(-500, -500, 50, 50), 1000, 2000, 80, 80)
+        assertTrue(s.left >= 0 && s.top >= 0)
+        assertTrue(s.right <= 1000 && s.bottom <= 2000)
+        assertTrue(s.width >= 80)
+        assertTrue(s.height >= 80)
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun `clamp never inverts sides`() {
+        // тащим левую грань далеко за правую
+        val s = Region.clamp(Region.Box(900, 100, 980, 300), 1000, 2000, 80, 80)
+        assertTrue("left must stay left of right", s.left < s.right)
+        assertTrue(s.width >= 80)
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun `clamp moves whole box back inside screen`() {
+        val s = Region.clamp(Region.Box(950, 1900, 1050, 2100), 1000, 2000, 80, 80)
+        assertEquals(920, s.left)
+        assertEquals(1000, s.right)
+        assertEquals(2000, s.bottom)
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun `clamp survives screen smaller than minimum`() {
+        val s = Region.clamp(Region.Box(-50, -50, 500, 500), 300, 300, 400, 400)
+        assertTrue(s.left >= 0 && s.top >= 0)
+        assertTrue(s.right <= 300 && s.bottom <= 300)
+        assertTrue(s.width > 0 && s.height > 0)
+    }
+}

Отдельное приложение: плавающая кнопка поверх любых приложений (игры, сайты, скрины), тап — меню как в читалке Yomikai:

# Yomikai Оверлей — плавающий OCR-читатель поверх других приложений

Отдельное приложение: плавающая кнопка поверх любых приложений (игры, сайты, скрины), тап — меню как в читалке Yomikai:

- **OCR скан** — разово распознать рамку и прочитать текст вслух
- **Авточтение** — читает рамку и листает автопрокруткой (жест свайпа через спец. возможности)
- **Стоп чтения**
- **Голос** ♀ / ♂ / ⚙ (тембр системного TTS; настройки синтеза)
- **Скорость** −/+/1× (50%…200%)
- **Движок** — Tesseract RU+EN (офлайн, кириллица)
- **Область** — пресеты (весь экран/верх/центр/низ), **удержание** — рамку тянуть за 4 ручки по сторонам + угол
- Панель вниз / Скрыть пузырь 30 с / Закрыть (удержание)

## Установка
1. Скачать APK из Releases, установить.
2. Разрешить **«Показ поверх других приложений»** (из кнопки в приложении).
3. Для автопрокрутки: включить **«Yomikai Оверлей — прокрутка»** в спец. возможностях.
   Если пишет **«Доступ к настройкам ограничен»** (Android 13+, установка APK-файлом):
   Сведения о приложении → ⋮ правый верхний угол → **«Разрешить ограниченные настройки»** → вернуться и включить службу.
4. При первом скане/чтении система спросит разрешение на захват экрана — это системный диалог, появляется каждый новый запуск сервиса.

## Архитектура
- UI — нативные View (не Compose в окнах): класс крашей `ViewTreeLifecycleOwner not found` исключён полностью.
- `OverlayService` — bubble + панель + рамка + захват + OCR + TTS + цикл чтения.
- Двухфазный foreground: `mediaPlayback` при старте → `mediaPlayback|mediaProjection` после consent (фикс SecurityException Android 14+).
- `ScrollAccessibilityService` — свайп-листание в других приложениях.
- `CaptureConsentActivity` — прозрачная activity для системного запроса захвата.

## Сборка
GitHub Actions (`.github/workflows/build.yml`): ubuntu-latest, JDK 17, Gradle 8.7, tesseract data скачивается в CI, release собирается на тег.
Подпись — `keystore/yomikai-overlay.jks` в репозитории (личный проект; пароль в `app/build.gradle`).

467:                     if (!moved && (Math.abs(dx) > slop || Math.abs(dy) > slop)) moved = true
468:                     if (moved) {
469:                         val s = screenSize()
470:                         lp.x = clamp(startX + dx.toInt(), 0, s.x - v.width)
471:                         lp.y = clamp(startY + dy.toInt(), 0, s.y - v.height)
472:                         try { wm.updateViewLayout(mainRoot, lp) } catch (e: Exception) { }
473:                     }
474:                     true
475:                 }
476:                 MotionEvent.ACTION_UP -> {
477:                     if (!moved) toggleExpanded()
478:                     moved = false
479:                     v.performClick()
480:                     true
481:                 }
482:                 else -> false
483:             }
484:         }
485:     }

487:     private fun clamp(v: Int, lo: Int, hi: Int) = if (v < lo) lo else if (v > hi) hi else v

618:     private inner class RegionSelectView : View(this@OverlayService) {
619:         private var rect = Rect(regionRatio())
620:         private val zone = dp(48)
621:         private val border = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
622:             style = Paint.Style.STROKE
623:             strokeWidth = dp(3).toFloat()
624:             color = frameRed
625:         }
626:         private val fill = Paint().apply {
627:             style = Paint.Style.FILL
628:             color = Color.parseColor("#33FFFFFF")
629:         }
630:         private val handlePaint = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply { color = Color.WHITE }
631: 
632:         private var mode = 0 // 0..8: стороны/угол; -6 move
633:         private var lastX = 0f
634:         private var lastY = 0f
635: 
636:         fun currentRect() = Rect(rect)
637:         fun setRect(r: Rect) { rect = Rect(r); invalidate() }
638: 
639:         override fun onDraw(c: Canvas) {
640:             // затемнение снаружи
641:             val w = width
642:             val h = height
643:             c.drawRect(0f, 0f, w.toFloat(), rect.top.toFloat(), fill)
644:             c.drawRect(0f, rect.bottom.toFloat(), w.toFloat(), h.toFloat(), fill)
645:             c.drawRect(0f, rect.top.toFloat(), rect.left.toFloat(), rect.bottom.toFloat(), fill)
646:             c.drawRect(rect.right.toFloat(), rect.top.toFloat(), w.toFloat(), rect.bottom.toFloat(), fill)
647:             c.drawRect(rect, border)
648:             // четыре прямоугольника-ручки по серединам сторон + уголок справа-снизу
649:             val hw = dp(44f).toFloat()
650:             val hh = dp(12f).toFloat()
651:             val cx = rect.centerX().toFloat(); val cy = rect.centerY().toFloat()
652:             val tops = arrayOf(
653:                 floatArrayOf(cx, rect.top.toFloat()),
654:                 floatArrayOf(cx, rect.bottom.toFloat())
655:             )
656:             for (t in tops) c.drawRoundRect(t[0] - hw / 2, t[1] - hh / 2, t[0] + hw / 2, t[1] + hh / 2, 8f, 8f, handlePaint)
657:             val sides = arrayOf(
658:                 floatArrayOf(rect.left.toFloat(), cy),
659:                 floatArrayOf(rect.right.toFloat(), cy)
660:             )
661:             for (t in sides) c.drawRoundRect(t[0] - hh / 2, t[1] - hw / 2, t[0] + hh / 2, t[1] + hw / 2, 8f, 8f, handlePaint)
662:             c.drawCircle(rect.right.toFloat(), rect.bottom.toFloat(), dp(16f).toFloat(), handlePaint)
663:         }
664: 
665:         override fun onTouchEvent(ev: MotionEvent): Boolean {
666:             val x = ev.x.toInt()
667:             val y = ev.y.toInt()
668:             when (ev.actionMasked) {
669:                 MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN -> {
670:                     lastX = ev.x
671:                     lastY = ev.y
672:                     mode = zoneFor(x, y)
673:                     return true
674:                 }
675:                 MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE -> {
676:                     val s = screenSize()
677:                     val dx = (ev.x - lastX).toInt()
678:                     val dy = (ev.y - lastY).toInt()
679:                     lastX = ev.x
680:                     lastY = ev.y
681:                     applyDrag(s, dx, dy)
682:                     invalidate()
683:                     return true
684:                 }
685:                 MotionEvent.ACTION_UP, MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL -> {
686:                     mode = 0
687:                     return true
688:                 }
689:             }
690:             return super.onTouchEvent(ev)
691:         }
692: 
693:         private fun zoneFor(x: Int, y: Int): Int {
694:             val nearL = Math.abs(x - rect.left) <= zone
695:             val nearR = Math.abs(x - rect.right) <= zone
696:             val nearT = Math.abs(y - rect.top) <= zone
697:             val nearB = Math.abs(y - rect.bottom) <= zone
698:             // углы имеют приоритет
699:             if (nearL && nearT) return 1
700:             if (nearR && nearT) return 2
701:             if (nearL && nearB) return 3
702:             if (nearR && nearB) return 4
703:             if (nearL) return 5
704:             if (nearR) return 6
705:             if (nearT) return 7
706:             if (nearB) return 8
707:             return if (rect.contains(x, y)) -6 else 0
708:         }
709: 
710:         private fun applyDrag(s: Point, dx: Int, dy: Int) {
711:             val minW = dp(80)
712:             val minH = dp(80)
713:             fun clampSides() {
714:                 if (rect.left < 0) rect.left = 0
715:                 if (rect.top < 0) rect.top = 0
716:                 if (rect.right > s.x) rect.right = s.x
717:                 if (rect.bottom > s.y) rect.bottom = s.y
718:                 if (rect.right - rect.left < minW) rect.right = rect.left + minW
719:                 if (rect.bottom - rect.top < minH) rect.bottom = rect.top + minH
720:             }
721:             when (mode) {
722:                 -6 -> rect.offset(dx, dy)
723:                 1 -> { rect.left += dx; rect.top += dy }
724:                 2 -> { rect.right += dx; rect.top += dy }
725:                 3 -> { rect.left += dx; rect.bottom += dy }
726:                 4 -> { rect.right += dx; rect.bottom += dy }
727:                 5 -> rect.left += dx
728:                 6 -> rect.right += dx
729:                 7 -> rect.top += dy
730:                 8 -> rect.bottom += dy
731:             }
732:             clampSides()
733:         }
734:     }

239: 
240:     fun hasRemaining() = pos < bytes.size
241: 
242:     fun readTag(): Int? = if (hasRemaining()) readVarint32() else null

244:     fun readBytes(): ByteArray {

247:         val result = bytes.copyOfRange(pos, pos + safeLen)

249:         return result

258:             2 -> { val len = readVarint32() ?: 0; pos += len.coerceAtMost(bytes.size - pos); if (pos > bytes.size) pos = bytes.size }

package app.yomikaioverlay.ot

import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.RectF

/**
 * User-editable engine and mode preferences. Every value persists in
 * SharedPreferences; the settings screen and the runtime routers both read
 * from here. No API keys are shipped; keys are entered by the user.
 */
object EnginePrefs {
    private const val P = "ot_engines"
    private fun sp(ctx: Context) = ctx.applicationContext.getSharedPreferences(P, 0)

    // Connectivity modes for the OCR/translate route.
    const val MODE_OFFLINE = "offline"
    const val MODE_MIXED = "mixed"
    const val MODE_COMBO = "combo"
    const val MODE_ONLINE = "online"

    // OCR engine ids.
    const val OCR_LOCAL = "local_cyrillic"
    const val OCR_GLENS = "glens"
    const val OCR_ZEN = "zen"
    const val OCR_GOOGLE_AI = "googleai"
    const val OCR_OPENROUTER = "openrouter"

    // Translate engine ids.
    const val TR_DICT = "dict"
    const val TR_GOOGLE = "google"
    const val TR_GOOGLE_AI = "googleai"
    const val TR_ZEN = "zen"
    const val TR_OPENROUTER = "openrouter"
    const val TR_MYMEMORY = "mymemory"
    const val TR_AUTO = "auto"

    // TTS source ids.
    const val TTS_AUTO = "auto"
    const val TTS_SYSTEM = "system"
    const val TTS_EDGE = "edge"

    fun ocr(ctx: Context) = sp(ctx).getString("ocr", OCR_LOCAL) ?: OCR_LOCAL
    fun setOcr(ctx: Context, v: String) = sp(ctx).edit().putString("ocr", v).apply()

    fun tr(ctx: Context) = sp(ctx).getString("tr", TR_DICT) ?: TR_DICT
    fun setTr(ctx: Context, v: String) = sp(ctx).edit().putString("tr", v).apply()
    fun trTargetLang(ctx: Context) = "ru"
    fun setTrTargetLang(ctx: Context, v: String) = Unit

    fun netMode(ctx: Context) = sp(ctx).getString("net_mode", MODE_MIXED) ?: MODE_MIXED
    fun setNetMode(ctx: Context, v: String) = sp(ctx).edit().putString("net_mode", v).apply()

    fun ttsSource(ctx: Context) = sp(ctx).getString("tts_source", TTS_AUTO) ?: TTS_AUTO
    fun setTtsSource(ctx: Context, v: String) = sp(ctx).edit().putString("tts_source", v).apply()

    // Scan behavior.
    fun live(ctx: Context) = sp(ctx).getBoolean("live", false)
    fun setLive(ctx: Context, v: Boolean) = sp(ctx).edit().putBoolean("live", v).apply()
    fun autoTranslate(ctx: Context) = sp(ctx).getBoolean("auto_translate", false)
    fun setAutoTranslate(ctx: Context, v: Boolean) = sp(ctx).edit().putBoolean("auto_translate", v).apply()
    fun speak(ctx: Context) = sp(ctx).getBoolean("speak", true)
    fun setSpeak(ctx: Context, v: Boolean) = sp(ctx).edit().putBoolean("speak", v).apply()
    fun voiceName(ctx: Context) = sp(ctx).getString("voice_name", "") ?: ""
    fun setVoiceName(ctx: Context, v: String) = sp(ctx).edit().putString("voice_name", v).apply()

    // Scan source language: "AUTO", "RU", "EN".
    fun scanLang(ctx: Context) = sp(ctx).getString("scan_lang", "AUTO") ?: "AUTO"
    fun setScanLang(ctx: Context, v: String) = sp(ctx).edit().putString("scan_lang", v).apply()

    // Frame behavior: "auto" (fit content area, insets removed), "rect" (manual),
    // or a FramePresets id like "page"/"chat"/"subs"/"article".
    fun regionMode(ctx: Context) = sp(ctx).getString("region_mode", "auto") ?: "auto"
    fun setRegionMode(ctx: Context, v: String) = sp(ctx).edit().putString("region_mode", v).apply()

    // Last picked frame rect (screen coordinates), survives service restarts.
    fun regionRect(ctx: Context): RectF? {
        val s = sp(ctx).getString("region_rect", "") ?: return null
        val parts = s.split(",")
        if (parts.size != 4) return null
        return try {
            RectF(parts[0].toFloat(), parts[1].toFloat(), parts[2].toFloat(), parts[3].toFloat())
        } catch (_: Exception) { null }
    }
    fun setRegionRect(ctx: Context, r: RectF) =
        sp(ctx).edit().putString("region_rect", "${r.left},${r.top},${r.right},${r.bottom}").apply()

    // Online engine credentials. Never shipped; user-configured.
    fun googleApiKey(ctx: Context) = sp(ctx).getString("google_api_key", "") ?: ""
    fun setGoogleApiKey(ctx: Context, v: String) = sp(ctx).edit().putString("google_api_key", v.trim()).apply()
    fun rotateGoogleKey(ctx: Context) = false
    fun googleModel(ctx: Context) = sp(ctx).getString("google_model", "") ?: ""
    fun setGoogleModel(ctx: Context, v: String) = sp(ctx).edit().putString("google_model", v.trim()).apply()
    fun openrouterKey(ctx: Context) = sp(ctx).getString("or_key", "") ?: ""
    fun setOpenrouterKey(ctx: Context, v: String) = sp(ctx).edit().putString("or_key", v.trim()).apply()
    fun orModel(ctx: Context) = sp(ctx).getString("or_model", "") ?: ""
    fun setOrModel(ctx: Context, v: String) = sp(ctx).edit().putString("or_model", v.trim()).apply()
    fun zenModel(ctx: Context) = sp(ctx).getString("zen_model", "") ?: ""
    fun setZenModel(ctx: Context, v: String) = sp(ctx).edit().putString("zen_model", v.trim()).apply()

    // Token accounting for online engines.
    fun tokenUsageCount(ctx: Context) = sp(ctx).getLong("token_usage", 0L)
    fun setTokenUsageCount(ctx: Context, v: Long) = sp(ctx).edit().putLong("token_usage", v).apply()
    fun incrementTokens(ctx: Context, plus: Long) {
        if (plus <= 0) return
        setTokenUsageCount(ctx, tokenUsageCount(ctx) + plus)
    }
}

22:             i.addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK or Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NO_HISTORY)

52:     }

59:                 OverlayService.startForegroundService(this) // поднять сервис, если ещё не

61:                 s.action = OverlayService.ACTION_PROJECTION
62:                 s.putExtra("resultCode", resultCode)

67:                 Toast.makeText(this, "Захват экрана отклонён", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()

69:         }

name: Build overlay APK

on:
  push:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'

      - name: Android SDK
        run: |
          yes | "$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager" --licenses || true
          "$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager" "platforms;android-34" "build-tools;34.0.0"

      - name: EN→RU словарик для перевода (из overlay-translator, ~2MB)
        run: |
          mkdir -p app/src/main/assets/dict
          curl -fL -o app/src/main/assets/dict/en_ru.json https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sj0404-collab/overlay-translator/master/app/src/main/assets/dict/en_ru.json
          du -sh app/src/main/assets

      - name: Gradle 8.7
        run: |
          curl -fL -o gradle.zip https://services.gradle.org/distributions/gradle-8.7-bin.zip
          unzip -q gradle.zip

      - name: Build release APK
        run: ./gradle-8.7/bin/gradle :app:assembleRelease --no-daemon --stacktrace

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: apk
          path: app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk

      - name: GitHub Release (on tag)
        if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')
        run: |
          mv app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk "yomikai-overlay-${{ github.ref_name }}.apk"
          gh release create "${{ github.ref_name }}" \
            --title "Yomikai Оверлей ${{ github.ref_name }}" \
            --notes "Плавающий OCR-оверлей поверх других приложений (интерфейс как плавающее меню читалки)." \
            "yomikai-overlay-${{ github.ref_name }}.apk" || true
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

Now I have a fairly complete picture. Let me check the environment: is Gradle/JDK/Android SDK available locally to build and test? Let me check.

Also let me check the git history to understand what the "bugs and dostorabotki" (недоработки) might be. Let me look at git log more and see if there are known issues. Let me also check the /home/runner/hub-work/yomikai-overlay/tmp directory.

Let me plan the tasks:

1. Verify build works (compile).
2. Identify bugs & incompleteness.

Let me start by listing potential bugs I noticed while reading:

**MainActivity.kt:**
- `onCreate` → `buildUi()`; `onResume` → `refresh()`. OK.
- In `buildUi`, `btnToggle` starts service even if `!Settings.canDrawOverlays(this)` — shows a toast but still starts the service. Minor bug: should not start if permission missing. Also, `startForegroundService` from background (activity is in foreground so OK).
- The engine cycle in MainActivity: `cur = p.getString("ocr_engine", "lens")`, cycles lens → zen → googleai → openrouter → lens. OK same as overlay.
- `rateBtn` cycles 1.0 → 1.25 → 1.5 → 1.75 → 2.0 → 0.5 → 0.75 → 1.0. Wait: r = 1.0 + 0.25 = 1.25; 1.5; 1.75; 2.0; then r > 2.0f → r = 0.5. Then 0.5 → 0.75 → 1.0. OK all 7 values. Fine.
- `prefs()` uses "ovr" shared prefs — same as OverlayService. OK.
- `ScrollAccessibilityService.instance` check OK.
- Missing: POST_NOTIFICATIONS request result handling - fine.
- **Bug**: In MainActivity `askNotifPermission` is called in `buildUi` which is called in onCreate. OK.

**OverlayService.kt:**

1. `onCreate` → `ensureForeground(false)` → `startForeground` with type MEDIA_PLAYBACK. On Android 14 (SDK 34), `startForeground` with FOREGROUND_SERVICE_TYPE_MEDIA_PROJECTION requires that projection consent was granted *before* — that's why two-phase. OK.

2. `ACTION_PROJECTION` handler: `intent.getParcelableExtra("data", Intent::class.java)` for SDK 33+. OK. But note: `CaptureConsentActivity` starts the service with `startService(s)` — the service may not be running (if user stopped it). `startService` on a service that isn't running: it will be created and `onStartCommand` called. That works even from background? For apps targeting 34, starting a service from background is restricted, but the app has an activity in the foreground at that moment (CaptureConsentActivity), so it's OK.

3. In `onStartCommand`, `ACTION_SCAN_ONCE` → `ensureForeground(projectionGranted)` — hmm, notification action arrives while service running. OK.

4. **Bug in `setPreset`**: `saveRegionRatio` writes "reg_preset" = "custom" always (line 512: `.putString("reg_preset", "custom")`). And `setPreset` sets preset before calling saveRegionRatio and again after — meaning saveRegionRatio resets it to "custom". So presets cycle always shows "Своя рамка" after any preset set! That's a real bug: `cycleRegionPreset()` sets preset to e.g. "full", but `saveRegionRatio(rectPx)` overrides with "custom", so `regionLabel()` returns "Своя рамка" and next cycle goes to `else -> setPreset("bottom",...)`. So the cycle becomes: bottom → full (but saved as custom) → then cycle again: since stored is "custom" → else → bottom. So you can never reach top/center presets. **BUG**.

   Fix: `saveRegionRatio(rectPx, preset: String? = null)` — preserve preset. When called from `setPreset`, keep "reg_preset" as is; when from RegionSelectView "Готово", set "custom".

5. `refreshFrame` visibility: frameView visible when `!hiddenSnooze && (expanded || autoReading)`. OK.

6. `openRegionSelect` — selectRoot window is MATCH_PARENT with touchable. The buttons at bottom. OK.

7. `RegionSelectView.zoneFor` — mode -6 for move if inside. But touches inside the rect that aren't near handles move the rect. OK.

8. **Bug in `RegionSelectView.applyDrag`**: for move mode (-6), `rect.offset(dx, dy)` can push rect off-screen: `clampSides` clamps left<0→0, top<0→0, right>s.x→s.x, bottom>s.y→s.y, but if rect is smaller than screen and offset down beyond, then `rect.bottom > s.y` → `rect.bottom = s.y` — that moves the whole rect up, fine (keeps size). But for corners where left += dx causes left<0 → left=0; right-left may become < minW → right = left + minW. OK. But there's an issue: when dragging left side to the right beyond `right - minW`, left can exceed right, making rect inverted. clampSides doesn't handle left > right - minW. Let me add proper clamping: after clamping, ensure left <= right - minW etc.

9. **`captureScreen`**: `setOverlayAlpha(0.0f)` then sleep 150ms then create ImageReader, sleep 480ms, acquireLatestImage. Overlay alpha set on `ui` (main) thread; `captureScreen` runs on ocrHandler thread. `setOverlayAlpha` posts to ui thread — asynchronous; the 150ms sleep helps. Fine-ish. Note `rowPadding` computation: `rowStride - pixelStride * w`, could be negative? Usually non-negative. `Bitmap.createBitmap(w + rowPadding / pixelStride, h, ...)`. If rowPadding negative, `w + negative` could be < w, and `copyPixelsFromBuffer` would fail or write wrong. Many devices have rowPadding >= 0. To be safe, `coerceAtLeast(w)`.

10. **TTS `ensureTts`**: `tts = TextToSpeech(applicationContext) { status -> ... }` — the init listener sets `ttsReady`. But there's a race: `speak()` checks `t == null || !ttsReady` → `ui.postDelayed({ speakNow(text) }, 650)` — `speakNow` re-checks `ttsBackend() == "edge"` → `speakEdge` OK. For system: `speakNowSystem` uses `t = tts ?: return` — if tts not yet bound, `tts` is non-null (constructor called), but ttsReady false; `speakNowSystem` doesn't check ttsReady. Speaking before engine ready may silently fail. Should check `ttsReady`. Let me fix `speakNowSystem` to check ttsReady and retry.

11. `speak()` — if `tts == null` → ensureTts() then postDelayed speakNow. If tts non-null but !ttsReady → postDelayed speakNow — but speakNow for system backend doesn't wait for readiness. **Bug**.

12. **UtteranceProgressListener `onError(utteranceId)` deprecated** — used for old API. Also the listener's `onDone` sets `speaking = false` and schedules `scrollAndContinue`. But for Edge TTS backend, system TTS progress listener is never invoked — instead `playEdgeAudio` completion listener handles it. OK. But note: if Edge TTS fails and falls back to system, `speakNowSystem` sets speaking = true and the utterance listener will fire onDone → scrollAndContinue. OK.

13. **`stopAutoRead`**: stops mediaPlayer and tts. But `speakEdge`'s `playEdgeAudio` sets completion listener; when stopped, `onCompletion` won't fire; `speaking=false` set in stopAutoRead. OK. But `speakEdge` runs in a Thread; if synthesis completes after stop, it posts playEdgeAudio and audio starts playing even though auto-read was stopped! **Bug**: stopAutoRead should set a flag/generation counter so late Edge playback doesn't start. Also `speak()` can be called while autoRead. Let me add a `speakGeneration` counter incremented on stopAutoRead/onDestroy; `playEdgeAudio` checks generation before playing.

The debug build succeeds. Now let me make a todo list of the bugs/недоработки I found and fix them systematically. Then add tests.

Let me organize the work:

**Bugs (functional):**
1. **Region preset cycling broken** — `saveRegionRatio` always writes `reg_preset="custom"`, so "Верхняя половина"/"Центральная половина" unreachable; label shows "Своя рамка" after choosing any preset.
2. **Leaked window** — `removeAllWindows()` doesn't remove `voiceWin` (voice picker overlay window) → WindowManager leak / BadTokenException when service destroyed while picker open.
3. **Edge TTS audio can start after stop** — stopAutoRead/onDestroy don't prevent `playEdgeAudio` from starting playback in-flight; need a generation counter.
4. **System TTS race** — `speakNowSystem` doesn't check `ttsReady`; speech lost if engine still initializing.
5. **START_STICKY restart** — `onStartCommand` with null intent doesn't call `startForeground` again → ANR/crash (ForegroundServiceDidNotStartInTimeException / service killed).
6. **Gemini parse in `LlmClient.postJson`** — parses chat-style `choices` for Gemini endpoints → `translateGemini`/`visionGemini` always return null; translation silently falls back.
7. **Auto-read never stops at end** — `repeatCount` incremented but never used → infinite loop of scrolling+scanning forever.
8. **`Translator` auto fallback** — `MangaTranslatorService.translate` never returns null → mymemory fallback dead; also should check network errors. Minor.
9. **RegionSelectView drag** — corners can invert (left > right - minW) → negative width rect → crash in Bitmap.createBitmap / weird frame. `clampSides` insufficient for moves/corners.
10. **captureScreen overlay hiding** — voiceWin/selectRoot stay visible during capture (dim overlay captured in screenshot); also `rowPadding` can be negative → createBitmap size smaller than w → crash (ArrayIndexOutOfBounds in copyPixelsFromBuffer or wrong crop).
11. **MainActivity starts service without overlay permission** — toast shown but service started anyway.
12. **MediaProjection callback not registered pre-34** — if projection stopped (user revokes), state stuck true.

**Недоработки (incompleteness):**
13. **Zen Free engine doesn't use the free AI hub** — `LlmClient.ZEN_FREE` models + `visionOcr` unused; ZenFreeOcrEngine is a Lens wrapper while UI claims "бесплатный ИИ-хаб". Implement: try each ZEN_FREE model via `LlmClient.visionOcr`, fall back to Lens.
14. **Token usage never shown** — EnginePrefs tracks tokens; show in MainActivity + maybe panel.
15. **Bubble not re-clamped after rotation** — `onConfigurationChanged` only refreshFrame; clamp mainLp within new bounds.
16. **`showMain(false)` repeats** — cancel pending restore on repeated taps (use a Runnable ref).
17. **README outdated** — describes Tesseract/offline + "автопрокрутка через жест свайпа" без уточнения; update architecture section to match code (online engines, Edge TTS, two-phase foreground, Glens/Zen/Gemini/OpenRouter).
18. **`scanOnceNow`/`autoReadNow` unused & unsafe (`startService` from background)** — they're dead code; either remove or make safe. I'll make them use startForegroundService (safer) — actually simplest: remove? They might be intended for future use. Check usages: grep.
19. **Engine switching hint for "lens"** — panel sub-label says "бесключевой endpoint — самый простой" — fine.
20. **Locale in translate**: `Translator` mode strings unused — leave.

Also **CI workflow**: add debug build/test (unit tests) step so tests run in CI. And assets download: keep.

Also **LocalDictionary `lookup`** — `hit` returned as-is (UPPERCASE Russian senses per docstring). `translateFragment` uses `lookup(t) ?: t`. If values are UPPERCASE ("ПРИВЕТ"), the TTS reading uppercase is fine but ugly. The docstring says "flat JSON map of lowercase English word → UPPERCASE Russian sense". Hmm — if used, output would be uppercase. Apply `.lowercase()`? I can't see the JSON (downloaded in CI). Safer: keep as is but this path is never reachable from UI (translate auto → never dict). Leave.

Also **`MainActivity.rateBtn`** cycles 0.5→2.0 — matches panel range. OK.

Let me also double-check `scanOnce` for the hidden case: `setExpanded(true)` — expands panel. OK.

One more: **`OverlayService.notifyStatus`** — `content.length > 160` truncation + BigTextStyle — fine.

**Another important one**: `onStartCommand` — `ACTION_SCAN_ONCE` calls `ensureForeground(projectionGranted)`; but if the service was started via `startService` (not foreground) from PendingIntent while app in background... Notifications' PendingIntent.getService for a foreground service is allowed. OK.

**Another**: `OverlayService.startForegroundService` catches exception → `ctx.startService(i)`. On O+ background start throws IllegalStateException. Whatever, MainActivity calls it in foreground.

Now — one more significant bug: **`speak()` when `ttsReady` false for system backend** — code:
```kotlin
private fun speak(text: String) {
    if (text.isBlank()) return
    ensureTts()
    val t = tts
    if (t == null || !ttsReady) {
        if (tts == null) ensureTts()
        ui.postDelayed({ speakNow(text) }, 650)
        return
    }
    speakNow(text)
}
```
`speakNow` → `speakNowSystem` uses `t.speak` — if `ttsReady` false, speak fails silently (onError?). Actually `TextToSpeech.speak` before init success returns ERROR. The utterance listener may not fire → `speaking` stuck true → auto-read chain dead. Must fix.

Also **Edge TTS failure fallback**: `speakNowSystem(text)` when tts not ready → also fails → autoRead stuck (onDone never fires). Add retry logic that waits for readiness.

For **speaking flag + onDone chain**: `speakNowSystem` sets `speaking = true` — the only thing clearing it is onDone. If speak fails immediately (ERROR), `onError` fires (deprecated variant on some versions) → onDone. On API 23+ both onError(String) deprecated and onError(String,int) exist; overriding only the deprecated one — on modern devices `onError(utteranceId, errorCode)` default implementation calls `onError(utteranceId)`? Let me check: `UtteranceProgressListener.onError(String utteranceId, int errorCode)` — the base class `onError(String)` is the deprecated one. In AOSP, `UtteranceProgressListener` has:
```java
public abstract void onStart(String utteranceId);
public abstract void onDone(String utteranceId);
@Deprecated
public abstract void onError(String utteranceId);
public void onError(String utteranceId, int errorCode) { onError(utteranceId); }
public void onStop(String utteranceId, boolean interrupted) { onError? }...
```
Actually `onStop(String, boolean)` exists since API 23: default impl does nothing? Let me recall: In API 23+, `onStop(utteranceId, interrupted)` was added; its default implementation calls `onError(utteranceId)`? Hmm. To be safe, override `onError(String, Int)` and `onStop(String, Boolean)` too. But overriding `on stop` — careful: `onStop` is called when speak is interrupted by stop/flush. In `stopAutoRead` we set speaking=false directly anyway.

I'll modernize the listener: override `onStart`, `onDone`, `onError(String)`, `onError(String, Int)`, `onStop(String, Boolean)`.

Now implement everything. Let me create the todo list and start.

Plan of edits:

### A. OverlayService.kt
1. `saveRegionRatio(rectPx: Rect, preset: String? = null)` — only set "custom" when preset==null. `setPreset` passes name.
2. `removeAllWindows()` — remove `voiceWin` too, null it.
3. `setOverlayAlpha` — also hide `voiceWin` and `selectRoot` (store previous alphas and restore).
4. Edge TTS generation guard: `@Volatile private var speakGen = 0L`; increment in `stopAutoRead()` and `onDestroy()`; `speakEdge` captures gen at start; `playEdgeAudio(file, gen)` checks `gen == speakGen` before playing, else delete file.
5. `speakNowSystem` — check `ttsReady`; if not ready, retry via `speak()`'s delayed path. Also robustify listener.
6. `onStartCommand` — handle null intent / unknown action: `ensureForeground(projectionGranted)`.
7. `autoStep` — stop after repeatCount >= threshold with message "Достигнут конец страницы (или текст не меняется)".
8. `RegionSelectView.applyDrag` — proper clamping (left/right/top/bottom with min size, no inversion, keep within screen).
9. `captureScreen` — `rowPadding.coerceAtLeast(0)`, guard createBitmap width; also skip if `w + padding <= 0`.
10. `grantProjection` — register callback for SDK >= 29 (not just 34) so state resets; callback resets and rebuilds panel + notifyStatus.
11. Bubble re-clamp on rotation: in `onConfigurationChanged`, clamp mainLp x/y to new screen size and `wm.updateViewLayout`.
12. `showMain(visible)` — cancel previous restore runnable; drop `hiddenSnooze` duplication.
13. Use `EnginePrefs.incrementTokens` with real usage for Zen (after implementing engine below).
14. Also hide `voiceWin`/`selectRoot` — the setOverlayAlpha fix covers capture.

### B. ZenFreeOcrEngine.kt
Rewrite to actually use free AI hub `LlmClient.visionOcr` across `LlmClient.ZEN_FREE` models; if all fail, fall back to Lens; count real tokens if the response provides them... `postJson` currently returns only the message text (no usage). I could add an overload returning both text and tokens. Simpler: `LlmClient.visionOcr` returns String?; add `LlmClient.visionOcrWithUsage` returning Pair<String, Int>? Let me refactor: `postJsonRaw(endpoint, bearer, body): JSONObject?` then callers parse text + usage. Keep `postJson` for compatibility (used elsewhere), add `postChatFull` returning text+totalTokens.

Actually cleaner: add to LlmClient:
```kotlin
data class ChatResult(val text: String, val tokens: Long)
fun chatFull(endpoint: String, bearer: String?, model: String, prompt: String, maxTok: Int): ChatResult?
fun visionFull(bmp, model, russianOnly, scanMode): ChatResult?
```
and `postJson` delegates to `postChatFull(...)?.text`. Then ZenFreeOcrEngine uses `visionFull` per model, accumulates tokens via EnginePrefs.incrementTokens.

internal fun readVarint32(): Int? {
    var result = 0L
    var shift = 0
    while (shift < 64) {

}

internal fun readVarint64(): Long? {

        val b = bytes[pos++].toInt() and 0xFF
        result = result or ((b.toLong() and 0x7F) shl shift)
        if ((b and 0x80) == 0) return result
        shift += 7
    }

}

input.content:
# Yomikai Оверлей — плавающий OCR-читатель поверх других приложений

Отдельное приложение: плавающая кнопка поверх любых приложений (игры, сайты, скрины), тап — меню как в читалке Yomikai:

- **OCR скан** — разово распознать рамку и прочитать текст вслух
- **Авточтение** — читает рамку и листает автопрокруткой (жест свайпа через спец. возможности); останавливается сам, если текст в рамке перестал меняться
- **Стоп чтения**
- **Голос** ♀ / ♂ / ⚙ (тембр системного TTS; сетевые голоса Edge + список для выбора; проба голоса тапом)
- **Скорость** −/+/1× (50%…200%)
- **Движок** — только онлайн: Google Lens (без ключа) / Zen Free (ИИ-хаб, фолбэк на Lens) / Google AI Gemini Vision / OpenRouter Vision
- **Перевод** ⇄ — латиница → русский перед озвучкой (Zen → Google Translate → MyMemory)
- **Область** — пресеты (весь экран/верх/центр/низ), **удержание** — рамку тянуть за 4 ручки по сторонам + угол
- Панель вниз / Скрыть пузырь 30 с / Закрыть (удержание)

## Установка
1. Скачать APK из Releases, установить.
2. Разрешить **«Показ поверх других приложений»** (из кнопки в приложении).
3. Для автопрокрутки: включить **«Yomikai Оверлей — прокрутка»** в спец. возможностях.
   Если пишет **«Доступ к настройкам ограничен»** (Android 13+, установка APK-файлом):
   Сведения о приложении → ⋮ правый верхний угол → **«Разрешить ограниченные настройки»** → вернуться и включить службу.
4. При первом скане/чтении система спросит разрешение на захват экрана — это системный диалог, появляется каждый новый запуск сервиса.

## Архитектура
- UI — нативные View (не Compose в окнах): класс крашей `ViewTreeLifecycleOwner not found` исключён полностью.
- `OverlayService` — bubble + панель + рамка + захват + OCR + TTS + цикл чтения.

display.text:
name: Build overlay APK

on:
  push:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'

      - name: Android SDK
        run: |
          yes | "$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager" --licenses || true
          "$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager" "platforms;android-34" "build-tools;34.0.0"

      - name: EN→RU словарик для перевода (из overlay-translator, ~2MB)
        run: |
          mkdir -p app/src/main/assets/dict
          curl -fL -o app/src/main/assets/dict/en_ru.json https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sj0404-collab/overlay-translator/master/app/src/main/assets/dict/en_ru.json
          du -sh app/src/main/assets

      - name: Gradle 8.7
        run: |
          curl -fL -o gradle.zip https://services.gradle.org/distributions/gradle-8.7-bin.zip
          unzip -q gradle.zip

      - name: Unit tests (debug)
        run: ./gradle-8.7/bin/gradle :app:testDebugUnitTest --no-daemon --stacktrace

      - name: Build release APK
        run: ./gradle-8.7/bin/gradle :app:assembleRelease --no-daemon --stacktrace

      - name: Upload test report
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: test-report
          path: app/build/reports/tests/testDebugUnitTest

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: apk
          path: app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk

      - name: GitHub Release (on tag)
        if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')
        run: |
          mv app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk "yomikai-overlay-${{ github.ref_name }}.apk"
          gh release create "${{ github.ref_name }}" \
            --title "Yomikai Оверлей ${{ github.ref_name }}" \
            --notes "Плавающий OCR-оверлей поверх других приложений (интерфейс как плавающее меню читалки)." \
            "yomikai-overlay-${{ github.ref_name }}.apk" || true
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
